brief:
US rapper Macklemore confirmed on Instagram that Ed Sheeran's team dropped him from an upcoming tour following his "Free Palestine" statements. The removal came after a campaign led by pro-Israel billionaire Robert Kraft, Middle East Eye reported.

Macklemore did not elaborate on the circumstances of his removal or provide further details about Kraft's involvement in the decision to pull him from the dates.
dek: Pro-Israel billionaire Robert Kraft led campaign to drop Macklemore from Ed Sheeran tour In a statement shared on Instagram, US rapper Macklemore confirmed that “Ed Sheeran and his team” had dropped him from the tour after he said “Free Palestine ”.
title: Pro-Israel billionaire Kraft led push to remove Macklemore from Sheeran tour
